label: VERIFIED
extraction: Loop Design Check worked example: nightly green-keeper loop. Naive goal: 'make all tests pass' -> Step-1 self-check fails (failure mode #3). Decidable goal (fixed): 'all tests green AND no test file deleted or weakened AND coverage not lowered AND a change-list produced' - boundary now defined alongside done-criterion. Type: servo with retry cap of 3. Skeleton: plan/build/judge - judge is CI run independently, never the fixing agent. Review checklist catches what naive version missed: #3 hit (naive lets agent delete failing test to win) fixed by boundary 'no test file deleted/weakened'; #2 hit (fixing agent judging own fix would pass itself) fixed by 'judge = independent CI, deterministic'; #4 hit (ambiguous fix at 2am won't stop to ask) fixed by front-loading ambiguous fixes left for human; Red line: loop opens PR but does NOT auto-merge; human flips last switch (responsibility doesn't transfer). Naive loop and reviewed loop differ by four lines of constraint - difference between 'wakes you to deleted test suite' and 'wakes you to clean PR'.
